body.name: population cumulant-flag class
body.construction:
Let \(\Theta_{\mathrm{pop}}\) be the class of structural parameters
\[
 \theta=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,
          \{\epsilon_{u,e},\epsilon_{t,e}\}_{e\in\mathcal E},
          \epsilon_y)
\]
for which \(U_e=\epsilon_{u,e}\), \(T_e=\alpha U_e+\epsilon_{t,e}\), and \(Y_e=\beta T_e+\gamma U_e+\epsilon_y\) in every environment, and which satisfy every member property listed below.  No coefficient bound, fixed singular-value gap, finite inference-order cap, or source-swap closure is imposed in \(\Theta_{\mathrm{pop}}\).
